Game Overview

In GW Connect Electricity, the core idea is straightforward: connect and illuminate your virtual city in GW Connect Electricity, a puzzle game that challenges your strategic thinking. Align electricity poles with careful twists and turns through thirty electrifying levels. As you craft each circuit, relish the thrill of powering up your city while continuously enhancing your puzzle-solving techniques.
